rows.candidate_tier_decision: Dense training only when model memory communication and time-to-result require it; smaller runs may qualify for lower tiers
rows.qualification_measurements: model and batch size; peak HBM; GPUs and nodes; interconnect traffic; benchmark completion time

rows.candidate_tier_decision: Test mid-tier or H200 for parameter-efficient and small jobs; reserve dense-training tier for measured needs
rows.qualification_measurements: full versus parameter-efficient tuning; rollout versus update hours; peak HBM; precision; completion time

rows.candidate_tier_decision: Retain large-memory/high-precision tier only for measured FP64 HBM or bandwidth needs; assess CPU-only alternatives
rows.qualification_measurements: FP64 requirement; peak HBM; bandwidth; GPU busy time; CPU baseline; application benchmark

rows.candidate_tier_decision: Choose tier from actual training scientific or inference task; sensitive data changes access and site eligibility
rows.qualification_measurements: primary task; dataset governance; GPU memory and precision; job or token log

rows.candidate_tier_decision: Test mid-tier where model fits and throughput and latency pass; account for external SaaS
rows.qualification_measurements: self-hosted model; tokens; concurrency; p95/p99 latency; memory; server power

rows.candidate_tier_decision: Test mid-tier and serving optimization; count only distinct self-hosted requests
rows.qualification_measurements: token and context length; concurrent sessions; repeated calls; SaaS share; latency

rows.candidate_tier_decision: Real-time control local; training and simulation shared-site candidates; remote inference must pass service tests
rows.qualification_measurements: primary task; control latency and jitter; fail-safe; training hours; simulation hours
